import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
from sklearn.model_selection import train_test_split
from sklearn.feature_extraction.text import TfidfVectorizer
from sklearn.ensemble import RandomForestClassifier
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
import re
import os

# Create submission directory if it doesn't exist
os.makedirs("./submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")
sample_submission = pd.read_csv("./input/sample_submission_null.csv")


# Preprocess text function
def preprocess_text(text):
    if pd.isna(text):
        return ""
    # Remove surrounding quotes if present
    text = str(text).strip()
    if text.startswith('"') and text.endswith('"'):
        text = text[1:-1]
    # Decode unicode escapes
    text = text.encode("utf-8").decode("unicode_escape")
    return text


# Apply preprocessing
train_df["cleaned_comment"] = train_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)
test_df["cleaned_comment"] = test_df["Comment"].apply(preprocess_text)

# Create combined TF-IDF features (word + character n-grams)
word_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    ngram_range=(1, 3), max_features=10000, min_df=2, max_df=0.95, sublinear_tf=True
)

char_vectorizer = TfidfVectorizer(
    analyzer="char",
    ngram_range=(3, 5),
    max_features=5000,
    min_df=2,
    max_df=0.95,
    sublinear_tf=True,
)

# Fit and transform
word_features = word_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["cleaned_comment"])
char_features = char_vectorizer.fit_transform(train_df["cleaned_comment"])

# Combine features
from scipy.sparse import hstack

X_train = hstack([word_features, char_features])
y_train = train_df["Insult"].values

# Split into train and validation
X_train_split, X_val, y_train_split, y_val = train_test_split(
    X_train, y_train, test_size=0.2, random_state=42, stratify=y_train
)

# Train Random Forest classifier
rf_model = RandomForestClassifier(
    n_estimators=200,
    max_depth=15,
    min_samples_split=5,
    min_samples_leaf=2,
    random_state=42,
    n_jobs=-1,
    class_weight="balanced",
)

rf_model.fit(X_train_split, y_train_split)

# Predict on validation set
val_pred = rf_model.predict_proba(X_val)[:, 1]

# Calculate AUC-ROC
val_auc = roc_auc_score(y_val, val_pred)
print(f"Validation AUC-ROC: {val_auc:.6f}")

# Transform test data
test_word_features = word_vectorizer.transform(test_df["cleaned_comment"])
test_char_features = char_vectorizer.transform(test_df["cleaned_comment"])
X_test = hstack([test_word_features, test_char_features])

# Predict on test set
test_pred = rf_model.predict_proba(X_test)[:, 1]

# Create submission file
submission = pd.DataFrame(
    {
        "Comment": sample_submission["Comment"],
        "Date": sample_submission["Date"],
        "Insult": test_pred,
    }
)

submission.to_csv("./submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print(f"Submission saved to ./submission/submission.csv")
print(f"Number of predictions: {len(test_pred)}")
